title: wb start <KEY>: one command to pick up a ticket
desc:
Picking up work is wb task get, wb flow start and wb route today: three commands for one intent.

ACCEPTANCE:
- wb start <KEY> fetches the ticket into triage.json, creates or checks out the branch per the flow, and prints the route and the single next command (as wb next does)
- rerunning it on a ticket already started is a no-op that prints where it stands
- every failure names the fix, as the other commands do
